item.title: Argentina set up England semi-final with extra-time victory over Switzerland
item.description:
Argentina’s Unyielding Spirit Propels Them Past Switzerland

In a pulsating extra-time encounter, Argentina scripted a thrilling 3-1 victory over 10-man Switzerland in Kansas City, setting up a highly anticipated World Cup semi-final showdown with England on Wednesday, 15 July. The match, marked by moments of brilliance and controversy, showcased the Argentine team’s unwavering determination and resilience.

As the match entered the high-stakes extra-time period, Argentina emerged from the shadows with a newfound sense of purpose, capitalizing on Switzerland’s numerical disadvantage to score twice and seal their semi-final berth. The Swiss, despite their valiant efforts, ultimately succumbed to the relentless pressure exerted by Argentina, whose players displayed a dogged refusal to yield. This dramatic turn of events sets the stage for a captivating encounter between Argentina and England, with the world watching in anticipation.
